governanceNotes: D1 batch 30 (2026-09-23): deferred. Erythema induratum/nodular vasculitis is a lobular panniculitis whose ulceration and residual scarring are part of the lesion's own natural course (Borroni 2013 lists ulceration among the diagnostic findings of the entity itself; Carlson 2007 documents the vasculitis-panniculitis pathology), so an outgoing scar-target edge would largely restate the presentation - the same manifestation-identity barrier that closed diplopia (ME-41 pattern). The tuberculosis association runs in the direction tuberculosis -> EI (EI as a tuberculid), so any tuberculosis-linked outcome belongs to the tuberculosis mapping rather than the EI identity (wrong-direction guard), and the Requena 2002 review confirms the reactive-classification framework.

No catalog identity exists for chronic pretibial ulceration as a distinct entity (the decubitus-ulcers identity is pressure-scoped and clinically discordant), and the lymphedema literature for EI is case-report class without denominators. Reopening condition: cohort evidence of an EI-attributable functional outcome with a catalog-fit target would justify re-screening.
